summary: San Francisco Bay Area, software developer with a focus on full-stack development, holds a Master's in Information Systems (MIS) with coursework in Computer Science, strong advocate for software quality and best practices, critical of Agile methodologies, passionate about database design and optimization, has a history of mentoring and training junior developers, believes in the importance of ethical software development, critical of offshoring and H1B visa practices, supports labor rights and fair wages, has a daughter, enjoys pool and outdoor activities, skeptical of mainstream media narratives, values historical context in discussions, has a strong interest in technology trends and their societal impacts.
